_readme: THE KIND x BIOME DENSITY TABLE: how much of the occupancy cap each asset
class may use, per biome, 0.0..1.0 (exported as per-mille; the engine
REFUSES values above 1.0 -- the table may only thin, never boost, because
a placement policy may only veto sites). 1.0 everywhere reproduces the
pre-table world exactly. Missing kinds or biomes read as 1.0.
This is the knob the 2026-08-18 census showed was missing: biome weights
saturate the occupancy cap, so every rich biome carried the same density
(savanna == temperate forest) and the single per-layer density did all
the work everywhere. This table scales the KEEP test per kind per biome,
linearly, after the species pick -- see docs/placement-spec-schema.md.
Any edit here changes the manifest: worldgen change, kWorldGenVersion
bump, goldens re-blessed, per the v24 contract.
